evaluation_question: 判定の境界を保ち、問題・推奨・利用者の判断・次の行動が読み取れるか
hypothesis: 理由付き推奨と必要な判断の明示で利用者の行動が読み取れる
counter_hypothesis: 指示の追加が冗長化、不要な質問、過剰設計を増やす

execution.generator_isolation: Fresh context per condition; five cases in each context; only skill, reference and prompt-only requests. No rubric, prior outputs or condition labels.
execution.blind_grading: Fresh grader receives frozen rubric and anonymous outputs, not condition mapping or skill.
execution.observation: Semantic requirements and prohibited actions; scope case measures instructed routing, not automatic discovery.

gate.normal: at least 12 of 15 overall; each of decision/agreed-defect/measurement has at least 2 normal requirements met
gate.decision_invariants: No weakened verdict, invented acceptance or implementation authority
gate.limits: Public synthetic cases, no unseen holdout or statistical superiority. Real user comprehension remains unmeasured; user authorized merge after closed evaluation on 2026-09-27.
